description: Income and employment fields extracted from a borrower's loan documents (pay stubs, W-2s, tax returns, and employment verification letters). Any field not present in a given document should be null.

document_type.description: The kind of income/employment document, e.g. 'pay stub', 'W-2', 'tax return', 'employment verification letter'.

employee_name.description: Full name of the employee / borrower.

employer_name.description: Name of the employer or company issuing the document.

employer_address.description: Employer's mailing address, as a single line.

mailing_address.description: Employee's / borrower's mailing or home address, as a single line.

employment_start_date.description: Date employment began, in YYYY-MM-DD format if available.

pay_period_start.description: Start date of the pay period (pay stub), in YYYY-MM-DD format if available.

pay_period_end.description: End date of the pay period (pay stub), in YYYY-MM-DD format if available.

pay_date.description: Date wages were paid (pay stub), in YYYY-MM-DD format if available.

gross_pay_current.description: Gross pay for the current pay period, as a number without currency symbols.

net_pay_current.description: Net (take-home) pay for the current pay period, as a number without currency symbols.

gross_pay_ytd.description: Year-to-date gross earnings, as a number without currency symbols.

total_deductions.description: Total deductions for the current pay period, as a number without currency symbols.

annual_wages_w2.description: Annual wages, tips, and other compensation from W-2 Box 1, as a number without currency symbols.

tax_year.description: The tax year the document covers, e.g. 2025.
